name: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next
short: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next open-weights checkpoint (125B params, 6B active, 262K) previewing Qwen4 for efficient coding; Terminal-Bench 2.1 86.1%, LiveCodeBench 91.9%.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out; tool use
pricingNote: Vercel $0.12/$0.40 per 1M; open weights (Qwen Community license)
standout: A public peek at Qwen4’s direction: a tiny active footprint, strong efficient-coding scores, and weights you can run today.
tradeoff: It is a checkpoint, not a product — expect churn and breaking changes before the real Qwen4 ships.
